'''Jokskk Quosto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Jokskk Ouosto lived on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he worked at the [[Senate Commercial District]] below the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A bioanalyst, Quosto made a living passing on his knowledge of his trade to those who wished to learn.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jokskk Quosto appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a skill trainer for Bioanalysis on Coruscant.
